title.narrative: Implementation phase for the establishment of a College of Europe campus in Tirana

description.narrative: The action aims to support the implementation phase of the College of Europe campus in Tirana (Albania) and the first year of its Master's programme in the academic year 2024/2025. The new campus will provide to local and international students the necessary knowledge and skills to engage in the EU integration process and support the accession of the Western Balkans to the EU.
